sloka: एषा गोदावरी रम्या प्रसन्नसलिला शिवा ।अगस्त्यस्याश्रमो ह्येष दृश्यते पश्य मैथिलि ।। ६.१२६.४१ ।।
transliteration: eṣā godāvarī ramyā prasannasalilā śivā ।agastyasyāśramo hyeṣa dṛśyate paśya maithili ।। 6.126.41 ।।

translations.english: "Sita! Rshyamuka is seen covered with streaks of gold minerals, glowing like clouds with lightning."
